name: Default
shortDescription: Calibre ebook manager desktop app streamed to the browser, with a persistent library and configuration.

alerts.message: Sign in with the CUSTOM_USER and PASSWORD values from the environment. This basic auth is the only protection, and the web desktop includes a terminal with sudo inside the container. In the first-run wizard keep the library at /config/Calibre Library so it persists.
HTTPS is required; the browser desktop does not work over plain HTTP.
